items.summary: Working at the European Commission in EAC as a Graphic and Audiovisual…
items.content_html:
Working at the European Commission in EAC
as a Graphic and Audiovisual Desginer

I currently work at the European Commission as a Graphic Designer within the Directorate-General for Education, Youth, Sport and Culture. In this role, I contribute to the visual communication of European programmes and initiatives by creating graphic assets and communication materials for both digital and print platforms.

I collaborate on the development of visual content that supports major European programmes such as Erasmus+, European Solidarity Corps, and Creative Europe. My work involves designing communication pieces, ensuring brand consistency, and translating complex information into clear and engaging visual content for diverse audiences.

items.title: ASEPEYO (2023 - 2025)
items.summary: Working at Mutua Asepeyo as a Visual and Media Designer For a…
items.content_html:
Working at Mutua Asepeyo
as a Visual and Media Designer

For a year and a half, I worked at Mutua Asepeyo, where I had the opportunity to gain experience in various key areas. I collaborated in the creation of final artwork, graphic design elements, and audiovisual content production, always ensuring high-quality results.

I was involved in event organization, as well as in the filming, photography, and video creation related to these events. I also took charge of developing content for social media, helping to give a fresh approach to their digital strategy.

items.title: EUROLEAGUE (2023)
items.summary: Working at the EuroLeague Final Four as a Graphic Designer At MWD…
items.content_html:
Working at the EuroLeague Final Four
as a Graphic Designer

At MWD Creative Studios, I participated in the design and production of graphic material for the EuroLeague Final Four 2023. My work focused on creating large-scale designs, including advertising banners, posters, and vinyls that decorated the stadium during the event.

I was also responsible for developing advertising pieces for the tournament’s sponsors and collaborating on motion design projects, ensuring that each visual element met quality standards and reflected the brand’s identity.

items.title: CUATRECASAS (2022 - 2023)
items.summary: Working at the law firm Cuatrecasas as a Graphic Designer I worked…
items.content_html:
Working at the law firm Cuatrecasas
as a Graphic Designer

I worked in the Communications department at Cuatrecasas as a Graphic Designer, where I developed a wide range of key projects for the firm. One of the highlights was the Christmas invitation, where I created all the illustrations and animated the entire design using Motion Design.

Additionally, I designed materials such as screensavers, calendars, icons, business cards, and t-shirt prints.

I also had the opportunity to collaborate in the creation and conceptualization of a new brand called European Network, a project that unified different law firms under a common identity. My involvement ranged from the initial ideation to graphic design, contributing to the launch of this network with a coherent and professional image.

items.title: JAM
items.summary: Creation of a Mobile App JAM: New Brand and Communication Plan Master’s…
items.content_html:
Creation of a Mobile App JAM: New Brand and Communication Plan
Master’s Final Project

Jam is an app created for the final project of the Master’s in Art Direction in Advertising at Blanquerna University. This app functions as a social network to share, discover, and establish a closer connection between the musical artist and the listener, thus creating a community of people with similar musical tastes who can more easily discover new tracks.

Everything was built from scratch for this project: a naming, visual identity, values, features, and more, to successfully create the “JAM” brand.

All of this work is encompassed in a book that showcases the entire creative process behind the brand. The book was personally designed, and its cover features a mobile mockup with a QR code that allows access to the app prototype.

Cultural Television Channel
Creator, Designer and Motion

Cult is a fictional cultural television channel created during the Master’s in Art Direction. The development of this channel involved an entire process of ideation for its name, concept, and aesthetics, from which the final materials for the brand were created.

The main elements of the channel are the logo, chyrons, and the introductory spot. For this, design and motion design software were used.

items.title: SÓNAR 2022 - Festival Campaign (2022)
items.summary: Festival Campaign Creator, Editor, Art Direction The advertising campaign for Sónar 2022…
items.content_html:
Festival Campaign
Creator, Editor, Art Direction

The advertising campaign for Sónar 2022 was created during the Graphic Product Design course. It used emotions and chaos as main elements to convey fun and madness, reflecting the essence of the festival experience.

This project was selected and presented at the Museu Disseny Hub in Barcelona during the 2023 ACDCE (Arts Directors Club of Europe) call.
